## Summary Thesis
Md. Abrar Hossain is an interdisciplinary engineer turned Business Relationship Manager & Technical Project Leader at CompileQ, operating across Chattogram, Bangladesh and London E1, United Kingdom. He bridges commercial deal structuring, B2B stakeholder retention, and cross-functional engineering/design delivery.
